title: Analytic: plane-wave scattering by a small dielectric sphere (1D spherical multipoles, Mie)
description:
The sphere of em/tfsf_sphere_mie_3d (eps = 4, r = 60 nm, vacuum) solved by em_fdfd_sphere: a 1D spherical domain (coordinates spherical, size_y null; every radial cell is a whole shell) from the centre to 100 nm, 1 nm cells (60 inside the sphere, its surface on a cell edge), the outer end 'radiation' = the exact outgoing spherical wave of each multipole term (no PML, so the vacuum shell can be thin). A plane_wave (E along x, along +z, 1 V/m) in a frequency_domain study over 0.8-1.3 um, multipole orders 1..4, both families (er: electric multipoles a_l, hr: magnetic b_l); runs in well under a second on the cpu backend.
Analytic (Mie, dipole terms, as in the 3D example; m = 2, x = 2 pi r / lambda): Q_sca = sigma_sca / (pi r^2) = (6 / x^2) (|a1|^2 + |b1|^2) with |a1|^2 = 1 / (1 + (M_a / N_a)^2) from the closed-form psi1 / chi1; Q_sca(1 um) = 0.01422 (Rayleigh 0.01347). The 1D model also carries l = 2..4 (a2 ~1e-4 of Q).
Derived values tab: Q_sca_1000 = sigma_sca / (pi r^2) at 1 um vs the Mie value (the same name as in the 3D example: compare the two runs; the 3D FDTD reaches a few %, the 1D solve ~1e-4); A_over_S = sigma_abs / sigma_sca (lossless sphere: 0 to round-off, the discrete flux balance is exact); Q_ext_1000 = sigma_ext / (pi r^2) (= Q_sca here).
Spectra / Curves tab: em.wave series sigma_sca vs the dashed dipole Mie spectrum (~1 / lambda^4). Field tab: the sphere-mean |E|^2 and |E_r|, |E_t| radial profiles summed over the solved terms (last wavelength).
